response.content: The ledger does not report every calendar day; it only lists days with spend. It shows spend on five days (2026-09-29, 2026-10-02, 2026-10-06, 2026-10-07, 2026-10-13) within 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-28, but does not provide enough detail to confirm which of the remaining 29 days had zero spend. It cannot answer how many days had no spend at all.
